║  DEVELOPMENT SPEC — STEP-BY-STEP (intern / trainee friendly) ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

IDs: M07 / PAY-04 / PAY-04.02
You are the: API / Backend developer (.NET)
Application surface: Reception Portal
PDF feature (if any): Reception payment collection
PDF delivery note: Cash, UPI, card or payment link with printed receipt

ONE-SENTENCE GOAL:
  Make this true: “API: CollectAtReception; generate pay-link; print receipt payload”

════════ BUILD STEPS (follow in order) ════════
  STEP 1 — Write down request + response fields on paper from the Sub Task text.
  STEP 2 — Confirm which API host: New-API for new work; Old-API only if task is Login (or legacy Rx/Razorpay).
  STEP 3 — Add Controller + Service (or extend existing) in New-API/NIGA_NewAPI.
  STEP 4 — Add DTO/models; validate required fields; return clear error messages.
  STEP 5 — Enforce JWT auth + Role/DoctorId ownership (never trust client DoctorId blindly).
  STEP 6 — Implement GET/POST/PUT as named in the Sub Task; return JSON with shared IDs.
  STEP 7 — Test with Swagger/Postman (success + 401 + validation fail).
  STEP 8 — Tell UI/Mobile teammate the final URL + sample JSON.
  STEP 9 — Update Status; sync Module sheet.

════════ OUT OF SCOPE (do not build) ════════
  • Do not start another Sub Task ‘because it is related’ without Lead assigning it.
  • Do not hardcode secrets.

EXAMPLE (to make it concrete for trainees):
  Postman: POST/GET URL → 200 JSON with ids; without token → 401.

════════ HOW TO TEST YOURSELF (before asking mentor) ════════
  1) Re-read Sub Task text aloud — does your demo match every word?
  2) Wrong Role try (if security/UI): should be blocked or redirected.
  3) Refresh page / reopen app — still works?
  4) No console errors / no 500 on happy path.

════════ COMMON INTERN MISTAKES ════════
  • Building the whole Main Task instead of only this Sub Task
  • Forgetting route registration or role guard
  • Putting new APIs on Old-API (wrong — use New-API)
  • Marking Done without updating Module sheet Status
  • Leaving ‘Unassigned’ and no Notes when blocked

════════ DONE WHEN ════════
  • Statement is true on UAT: “API: CollectAtReception; generate pay-link; print receipt payload”
  • All Yes layers on this row = Done (Overall Status formula becomes Done)
  • Module sheet M07_* same Sub Task ID updated
  • Mentor can retest without you explaining orally

╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  DEVELOPMENT SPEC — STEP-BY-STEP (intern / trainee friendly) ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

IDs: M09 / TRU-02 / TRU-02.02
You are the: API / Backend developer (.NET)
Application surface: Admin Portal
PDF feature (if any): Verification review
PDF delivery note: Admin approves, rejects or requests more information before they can practise on the platform

ONE-SENTENCE GOAL:
  Make this true: “API: Queue, {id}, Approve, Reject, RequestInfo”

════════ BUILD STEPS (follow in order) ════════
  STEP 1 — Write down request + response fields on paper from the Sub Task text.
  STEP 2 — Confirm which API host: New-API for new work; Old-API only if task is Login (or legacy Rx/Razorpay).
  STEP 3 — Add Controller + Service (or extend existing) in New-API/NIGA_NewAPI.
  STEP 4 — Add DTO/models; validate required fields; return clear error messages.
  STEP 5 — Enforce JWT auth + Role/DoctorId ownership (never trust client DoctorId blindly).
  STEP 6 — Implement GET/POST/PUT as named in the Sub Task; return JSON with shared IDs.
  STEP 7 — Test with Swagger/Postman (success + 401 + validation fail).
  STEP 8 — Tell UI/Mobile teammate the final URL + sample JSON.
  STEP 9 — Update Status; sync Module sheet.

════════ OUT OF SCOPE (do not build) ════════
  • Do not start another Sub Task ‘because it is related’ without Lead assigning it.
  • Do not hardcode secrets.

EXAMPLE (to make it concrete for trainees):
  Postman: POST/GET URL → 200 JSON with ids; without token → 401.

════════ HOW TO TEST YOURSELF (before asking mentor) ════════
  1) Re-read Sub Task text aloud — does your demo match every word?
  2) Wrong Role try (if security/UI): should be blocked or redirected.
  3) Refresh page / reopen app — still works?
  4) No console errors / no 500 on happy path.

════════ COMMON INTERN MISTAKES ════════
  • Building the whole Main Task instead of only this Sub Task
  • Forgetting route registration or role guard
  • Putting new APIs on Old-API (wrong — use New-API)
  • Marking Done without updating Module sheet Status
  • Leaving ‘Unassigned’ and no Notes when blocked

════════ DONE WHEN ════════
  • Statement is true on UAT: “API: Queue, {id}, Approve, Reject, RequestInfo”
  • All Yes layers on this row = Done (Overall Status formula becomes Done)
  • Module sheet M09_* same Sub Task ID updated
  • Mentor can retest without you explaining orally

╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  DEVELOPMENT SPEC — STEP-BY-STEP (intern / trainee friendly) ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

IDs: M15 / MED-04 / MED-04.02
You are the: API / Backend developer (.NET)
Application surface: Patient + Pharmacy
PDF feature (if any): Prescription handoff / Order start
PDF delivery note: The signed prescription becomes the order directly — no re-entry, no transcription errors / Start an order directly from the prescription

ONE-SENTENCE GOAL:
  Make this true: “API: POST order from ErxId”

════════ BUILD STEPS (follow in order) ════════
  STEP 1 — Write down request + response fields on paper from the Sub Task text.
  STEP 2 — Confirm which API host: New-API for new work; Old-API only if task is Login (or legacy Rx/Razorpay).
  STEP 3 — Add Controller + Service (or extend existing) in New-API/NIGA_NewAPI.
  STEP 4 — Add DTO/models; validate required fields; return clear error messages.
  STEP 5 — Enforce JWT auth + Role/DoctorId ownership (never trust client DoctorId blindly).
  STEP 6 — Implement GET/POST/PUT as named in the Sub Task; return JSON with shared IDs.
  STEP 7 — Test with Swagger/Postman (success + 401 + validation fail).
  STEP 8 — Tell UI/Mobile teammate the final URL + sample JSON.
  STEP 9 — Update Status; sync Module sheet.

════════ OUT OF SCOPE (do not build) ════════
  • Do not start another Sub Task ‘because it is related’ without Lead assigning it.
  • Do not hardcode secrets.

EXAMPLE (to make it concrete for trainees):
  Postman: POST/GET URL → 200 JSON with ids; without token → 401.

════════ HOW TO TEST YOURSELF (before asking mentor) ════════
  1) Re-read Sub Task text aloud — does your demo match every word?
  2) Wrong Role try (if security/UI): should be blocked or redirected.
  3) Refresh page / reopen app — still works?
  4) No console errors / no 500 on happy path.

  • Forgetting route registration or role guard
  • Putting new APIs on Old-API (wrong — use New-API)
  • Marking Done without updating Module sheet Status
  • Leaving ‘Unassigned’ and no Notes when blocked

  • All Yes layers on this row = Done (Overall Status formula becomes Done)
  • Module sheet M15_* same Sub Task ID updated
  • Mentor can retest without you explaining orall

║  DEVELOPMENT SPEC — STEP-BY-STEP (intern / trainee friendly) ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

IDs: M16 / CON-03 / CON-03.02
You are the: API / Backend developer (.NET)
Application surface: Patient App (API now)
PDF feature (if any): Records timeline / Consultation note / Document upload
PDF delivery note: Complete visit history in date order / Doctor’s notes for each visit / Upload reports, scans and previous prescriptions

ONE-SENTENCE GOAL:
  Make this true: “GET timeline; GET consultation note (summary); POST documents”

════════ BUILD STEPS (follow in order) ════════
  STEP 1 — Write down request + response fields on paper from the Sub Task text.
  STEP 2 — Confirm which API host: New-API for new work; Old-API only if task is Login (or legacy Rx/Razorpay).
  STEP 3 — Add Controller + Service (or extend existing) in New-API/NIGA_NewAPI.
  STEP 4 — Add DTO/models; validate required fields; return clear error messages.
  STEP 5 — Enforce JWT auth + Role/DoctorId ownership (never trust client DoctorId blindly).
  STEP 6 — Implement GET/POST/PUT as named in the Sub Task; return JSON with shared IDs.
  STEP 7 — Test with Swagger/Postman (success + 401 + validation fail).
  STEP 8 — Tell UI/Mobile teammate the final URL + sample JSON.
  STEP 9 — Update Status; sync Module sheet.

════════ OUT OF SCOPE (do not build) ════════
  • Do not start another Sub Task ‘because it is related’ without Lead assigning it.
  • Do not hardcode secrets.

EXAMPLE (to make it concrete for trainees):
  Postman: POST/GET URL → 200 JSON with ids; without token → 401.

════════ HOW TO TEST YOURSELF (before asking mentor) ════════
  1) Re-read Sub Task text aloud — does your demo match every word?
  2) Wrong Role try (if security/UI): should be blocked or redirected.
  3) Refresh page / reopen app — still works?
  4) No console errors / no 500 on happy path.

════════ COMMON INTERN MISTAKES ════════
  • Building the whole Main Task instead of only this Sub Task
  • Forgetting route registration or role guard
  • Putting new APIs on Old-API (wrong — use New-API)
  • Marking Done without updating Module sheet Status
  • Leaving ‘Unassigned’ and no Notes when blocked

════════ DONE WHEN ════════
  • Statement is true on UAT: “GET timeline; GET consultation note (summary); POST documents”
  • All Yes layers on this row = Done (Overall Status formula becomes Done)
  • Module sheet M16_*

  • CON-03.03 [UI] — Consumed in Phase 16
  • CON-03.04 [QA] — QA: notes leak test on timeline JSON

  All sibling sub-tasks above are Done (or formally Deferred with client note).
  Then the feature “Records timeline + consultation note + document upload APIs” works end-to-end on UAT.
